messages:
julia (CMO): quick sanity check thread — we need 2 super-short differentiator claims and 3 field-ready soundbites for the launch post + webinar promo. focus vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors. keep them metric-ish but simple. any takes?
kai (product marketing): love it. goal: hero line (1) + 2 micro-bullets for battlecard. avoid heavy infra jargon. emphasize predictable cost, consistent latency, and rollout safety.
mike (growth): agree. for hero: 'Production inference that stays fast and predictable — wherever you run it.' short and broad.
samir (product): minor tweak: 'Predictable, production-grade inference — hosted, dedicated, or private.' makes the deployment modes explicit.
natalie (ops): add a cost hint: 'up to 3x cost savings vs naive endpoint scaling' — but we need backup. can't put numbers without a bench.
kai (product marketing): don't throw a ratio unless we have a verified benchmark. alternative micro-bullet: 'Cost controls: batching, cache, quantization recommendations that reduce unit cost.'
julia (CMO): good. want 3 soundbites for webinar slides and a short A/B pair for the hero. propose A: 'Run LLMs in production without the guesswork.' B: 'The inference runtime that preserves SLAs and reduces token costs.'
mike (growth): A is emotional, B is benefit-first. test both on signup landing. keep CTAs: 'See benchmarks' vs 'Try a fast demo'.
samir (product): quick battlecard bullets (2 lines each):
```
- Reliability: automatic fallbacks, cross-region routing, and SLA-backed Dedicated pools to keep apps online.
- Cost & performance: workload-aware batching, KV/prefix cache, and quantization profiles to cut per-token spend.
- Developer experience: same API across hosted/dedicated/private, built-in tracing + rollout controls.
```
kai (product marketing): those read well. shorten for field: 'Fallbacks & cross-region routing = fewer outages', 'Batching, cache & quantization = lower token cost', 'One API across environments = faster rollouts'.
julia (CMO): perfect. now messaging vs cloud AI platforms specifically — what's the crisp contrast?
mike (growth): clouds sell model access + infra. our angle: you get consistent inference economics and predictable latency independent of cloud burstiness and noisy neighbors. short line: 'Not just models — predictable inference.'
samir (product): another angle vs LLM APIs: data control + private deployments. 'Keep sensitive traffic in your VPC or on-prem, with Redwood handling the rest.'
ai-pr-bot (pr-bot): suggested press hook: 'Redwood Inference announces unified runtime to simplify production LLM deployments — predictable latency and opinionated cost controls.'
kai (product marketing): we also need inbound routing for leads who hit 'See benchmarks' vs 'Request private demo'. proposal: tag leads with webhook fields: {interest:benchmarks|private-deploy|dedicated} and route to Growth SDRs for bench requests and Solutions Eng for private demo. (Natalie to confirm capacity.)
natalie (ops): can do. just FYI: private-demo route takes 48-72h SLA for scheduling unless we fast-track. we'll add a 'priority: enterprise' flag for sales.
julia (CMO): timeline: hero copy + 3 bullets by EOD for content team. mike — A/B test on landing next week. kai — draft battlecard (one-pager) for sales by Thurs. samir — verify any numeric claims before Friday.
mike (growth): noted. I'll set up experiment and tracking events: landing_variant, cta_click, demo_request, bench_download.
kai (product marketing): I'll push the battlecard skeleton to the drive and tag @mike @samir for numbers.
samir (product): I'll pull the latest bench runs and give permissable phrasing. if we have a bench that shows median latency SLA + p95 under load, we can say 'maintains p95 latency under production pacing' — otherwise keep generic.
julia (CMO): OK team, last thing: 3 micro-soundbites for social posts — quick suggestions: 'Fast. Predictable. Portable.', 'Ship LLM features without re-architecting infra.', 'Reduce token spend with smart batching & caching.'
mike (growth): social versions sound good. I'll A/B on creatives.
kai (product marketing): logging action items in the doc now.
julia (CMO): thanks — we'll reconvene tomorrow AM. :rocket:
